trickyParts: A reopen cannot be told from another status move by status alone, so issue events now name closed_at in changed on a close or reopen; the client refreshes the whole Inbox and the project badges only then.

thread_logins on a status move names only logins with a Replies row on the issue's open asks (what myRepliesUnread can move), read through asks_open and user_threads_thread, so no scan of user_threads.

The scheduler counts a refresh as paid by any fetch that starts after it was asked for; a first-loading query's predicate runs on the landed body; nothing is ever cancelled (DispatchQueryClient covers mutation invalidations too).
The budget test's barrier renames the open issue until its detail is read again and the header shows the new title, so it works at both commits and under INFRA-258's transport.
deviations: Plan departure kept: acceptance 1's 50 links are in the spec and in one message; the test opens the Conversation tab (the live spec editor makes no per-reference read).
['artifact-ref'] is not dead (useProjectArtifact reads ['artifact-ref','P/slug']): narrowed to a data test on the artifact id instead of removed.

Added beyond the plan: closed_at in issue events' changed; references_changed names targets whose kept edge's excerpt moved and, on a retitle, the parent and blockers; the Inbox refreshes on block.* like the projects badge.
The contracts zod schemas list the new fields, so agents' parsed issue, message and ask notifications carry changed, ancestors and thread_logins (comment payloads already passed them through).

inbox.e2e.ts 'a later Inbox response clears a hidden ask's pending refresh' changed its ordering signal to a pinned-list read, because the held Inbox first load is no longer cancelled (spec item 5); its assertions are unchanged.
webkit and firefox projects of deep-links/delivery-live cannot launch in this pod (no browser binary); chromium and iphone are 169 passed, 0 failed.

Spec acceptance 3 and 4 (production check and the 10-minute request-log rate) run after the merge and the deploy; acceptance 4 also needs dispatch://INFRA-507 applied.
discoveredComplexity: A document mention is never named in references_changed, so a document's backlink panel refreshes only on focus/staleTime or a whole-cache refresh, as on main.
